answer: A bond of 34% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in sable, and ember reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 184 aliases, and each one needs its own funded violet account. That bill is paid per identity, so 206 aliases cost 177 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
